rci5_n.detail: Overall phase (10-fold cross-validation on whole sample); reference cohort includes BOTH cases (n=77) and controls (n=52), not HC only. Functional model: n=129 (77 cases + 52 controls). Structural model: n=127 (2 excluded from 129 due to bad image quality)
rci5_n.supporting_text: "A model of brain development as a function of age and sex was created by training a Gaussian process regression (GPR) model... on a sample of n = 129 and n = 127 (77 cases, Table 1, online Supplementary Fig. S3 for an age distribution) to predict brain function and structure, respectively" "Here, we used the whole cohort (both TD and DBD) as a reference due to the small sample size"
rci5_n.location: Holz2023.pdf.md: Method / Constructing normative models, L77-L79

rci6_sex.detail: Overall phase; whole cohort (cases + controls) used as reference. Model-1 (n=129): males from Table 1 (controls 34 + cases 64 = 98); female_n inferred as 129 - 98 = 31. Confirmed by Table S2 (Males No. = 98 for included sample N=129). Model-2 (n=127): sex breakdown not separately reported for this subset
